[Ethercalc](https://ethercalc.net/) is a web-based spreadsheet software.

The <a href="nixpkgs" class="wikilink" title="nixpkgs">nixpkgs</a> module system has a [module for ethercalc](https://search.nixos.org/options?type=packages&query=ethercalc).
